## 💇 Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Mac with Apple Silicon (M1–M4, Mac Studio…) | **GlamCam-macOS-AppleSilicon.zip** |
| Windows 10 / 11 | **GlamCam-Windows.zip** |

The Mac app is Apple Silicon only. Intel Macs can [run from source](https://github.com/jdonohoo/glamcam#step-2b--run-from-source).

## In the wig closet

Glaaron · 🎩 Top Hat · Glaaron Magnifique · 👑 The Ultimate Glaaron (hair + hat + mustache) · 🥸 The Mustache · Neon Mustache · Jeff Ears · Neon Jeff Ears (Jeff Mode) · 😎 **Shades** (new) · **Neon Shades** (new) · **Hoodie** (new) · Disco Inferno · Synthwave Mullet · Cyber Mohawk · The Executive. Press **n** to cycle.

## First launch

- **macOS:** unzip, drag **GlamCam.app** into **Applications**, double-click. The app isn't signed by Apple, so macOS blocks the first open. Go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/GlamCam.app`). Allow the camera when asked.
- **Windows** (lovingly full-sent: built and boot-tested by a robot, never by a human with a webcam): unzip anywhere, keep **GlamCam.exe** inside its folder, and double-click it. If SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway**.

GlamCam opens a window called **GlamCam** with your wig on. To get it into Google Meet, capture that window in OBS and start OBS's virtual camera. Full steps (including the one-time OBS setup) are in the [README](https://github.com/jdonohoo/glamcam#-getting-started).

Press **k** (or ⌘K / Ctrl+K) in the GlamCam window for the keys. **n** = next wig, **m** = add a mustache to any wig, **f** = 🦇 Cave Mode (freeze the costume, kill the lights, lurk with glowing blue eyes). **1–4** = 🪩 neon props on the wall behind you: Onboard sign, disco ball, floating neon keyboard, sucks to suck. **5** = 🐠 the Aquarium, **t** = who's in it: Discus, Angelfish, Stingray, Pleco or **Freshwater Community**; Manta Ray, Clownfish, Lionfish or **Saltwater Community**; or 🎉 **Party Mode** with every fish. **o** = hoodie, **g** = sunglasses, **x** = Mike Mode.
